title: Haven’t dreamed about the mall world (which I love) after going to an actual mall (which I hate) for the first time in years.
content: Basically what the title says. I don’t go to real malls and haven’t in years because I just really hate them and they make my anxiety go up. I had to go to one last week, multiple times, and got street harassed (which doesn’t really ever happen in my mall world) and just genuinely had an unpleasant time. Half the stores were closed or empty and it was just super depressing. Since then, I haven’t dreamed about the mall world, which is usually a nightly occurrence for me. Just curious if anyone else has experienced this.
